title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode4 Tension in the Air

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Line: The next day
Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, let's start discussing our next quarterly performance.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
It's titled “Luca”.
And it was written just for this performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They write stories just for these performances? But only the people at Morinomiya get to see them... Wow.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'll pass out the scripts now, so please take this time to flip through them quickly.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And don't forget to think about which roles you'd like to try auditioning for.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(“Luca”...
I wonder what it's about.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The protagonist, Luca Roussel, is a kind boy from a family of nobles.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He falls in love with the princess he meets in the rose garden, and he decides to try to become a suitable partner for her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(However, it's also a period of civil unrest...
In order to quell the rebellious masses, he becomes more cunning and tyrannical.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Before he knows it, his cruel ways have resulted in the lives of tens of thousands being brutally cut short.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In time, he becomes the youngest person in the history of the military to be named a deputy commander, which reunites him with the princess.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (However, she ends his reign of terror by cutting him down on the eve of a major suppression campaign.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Then, she weeps as she says, “I fell in love with the boy I met back in that garden. I didn't want to see your hands become even more stained in blood!!”)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But it also makes for a good story...
It's certainly dramatic, with the future of the country at stake.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Are you free to talk for a bit, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Byakkomachi, hi!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you'd like, I can take a minute to explain how these auditions work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I haven't really been told anything yet. Thank you very much for taking the time to help me like this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Hehe. There's no need to be so formal.
We're fellow classmates now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Then, I'll begin by explaining how these auditions will be run.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Their format is a bit unique compared to elsewhere. Over the course of two weeks, those who don't have what it takes will be cut along the way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cut...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In the beginning, everyone will be auditioning for their top choices.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, because multiple people will be vying for each role, we have to take turns performing individual scenes in front of the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, they can ask for the next person to go if at any point they feel that something is wrong.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Well, in the event they go through every candidate, they start over again with the first person.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
The teachers are difficult to please.
They'll stop you the second you show any doubt.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: At the end of each day, those who have been judged to lack what it takes will be barred from auditioning further.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, after that happens, what are those people supposed to do?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Audition for a different role.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you want to stand on that stage, then you have no choice but to try for something else like your life depends on it. In other words, your flexibility is also being observed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Which role do you plan on auditioning for, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My plan is to audition for Luca.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Luca's tricky, since you need to have very good singing and acting skills to do him justice. But playing him should also be a rewarding experience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, I'm going for the same role.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I won't be pulling any punches, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If Byakkomachi is going to audition for Luca, then things definitely aren't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I want to try playing a male character.
And I should go for Luca if I am serious about growing as an actress.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I need to try my absolute best to win...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, we'll be doing a read-through.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We'll be holding rehearsal-style auditions starting tomorrow, so please have your lines memorized by then.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Understood!!
Afterwards

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There was so much tension in the air during that read-through. Things got competitive when we were with Shunmeiza and Mikazukigumi, but not to this level....)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to be careful not to get overwhelmed.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're free to do whatever we want after this, so I might see if any of the others want to practice as a group. That should make it easier for me to learn my character.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see...
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, she's...

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, have you already received today's schedule? You're going to need it, so I can have a copy made if you don't have one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me.
Would you like to practice together?

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Huh? Together...?

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line:
I appreciate the invitation...
But I'm sorry.
I'd like to practice on my own.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
There she goes...
I guess she doesn't like practicing with others...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, I'll try asking someone else...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
You're wrong.
Luca wouldn't get so emotional during this scene.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
No, your interpretation is wrong.
He's having doubts because this is his first time taking up arms against the citizenry here. We should do it my way.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
We should not!
Seriously, did you actually read the script?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Uh oh...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Things are getting pretty heated over there...)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hey, stop it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Stop what?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Don't play dumb.
I know you were trying to peek at my notes just now.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
I was not.
We may be vying for the same role, but that doesn't give you the right to make any baseless accusations.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: If anything, my guess is that you came to spy on me practicing. You even copied me during the last audition.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
What...?!
I just happened to land on the same interpretation as you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Calm down, you two.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: We don't have much time to practice, so you shouldn't be spending any of it arguing.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I don't know if she did actually try to peek at your notes.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But I do know that this isn't how you should be using your time.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The same thing happened last time. While you two bickered, your competitors learned to play their characters better.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Also, even if you did somehow manage to win a role by spying on someone, the teachers will find out sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
So, let's all use our time productively.
Anyway, I'll see you all later.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't understand...
This atmosphere... Everyone's acting like...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Nothing like this happened when we auditioned with the other troupes...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I knew that things would be tough at Morinomiya.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But...
To think that the dazzling shows I'm used to seeing are born out of this sort of environment...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No...!
The kind of environment I've been tossed into doesn't matter!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've never auditioned for a character like Luca before. Not only is he challenging to play, there's fierce competition.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm sure to grow if I do somehow manage to win the role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, for the sake of my dream, I have to do absolutely everything in my power to play him!)
